item.title: Strangers helped a college student get to his friend in the hospital
item.description: While Jake Berry was in college, he learned one of his oldest friends was in the hospital more than an hour away. Berry didn't have a car, but two strangers gave him a ride.
item.content:encoded: While Jake Berry was in college, he learned one of his oldest friends was in the hospital more than an hour away. Berry didn't have a car, but two strangers gave him a ride.

item.title: How to film a movie with a million bees — and only 5 bee stings
item.description: A new movie starring Matthew McConaughey as a beekeeper uses real bees from Alabama. We visit the apiary where they live.
item.content:encoded: A new movie starring Matthew McConaughey as a beekeeper uses real bees from Alabama. We visit the apiary where they live.

item.title: 'Shrinking' star Jason Segel isn't afraid to share the 'dirty underneath'
item.description: "If I have a superpower that I can't take credit for ... [it's] that I'm very vulnerable," Segel says. He plays a widowed therapist who offers very blunt advice in the Apple TV series Shrinking.

item.title: In Portland, this soap box derby combines downhill speed with extreme pageantry
item.description: Soap box derbies send motorless cars down a steep incline. At one event, contestants make their cars look like cartoon characters, subway cars, food, and giant animals (among other outlandish shapes).

item.title: A summer camp celebrating Kazakh culture helps adopted kids connect with their culture
item.description: Families of children adopted from Kazakhstan meet every summer in New Hampshire's lake country to celebrate the food and culture of their country of origin.

item.title: Portland soap box derby race features a parade of creative gravity-powered cars
item.description: At Portland's annual soapbox derby, motorless cars race downhill pulled by nothing more than gravity. It's part race, part parade, with cars built to look like sharks, guitars and slices of cake.

item.title: In 'Etna,' a canine narrator delivers a poignant anti-war message
item.description: Paul Yoon's new novel follows a dog conscripted into an unnamed war in an unnamed country. From the very first page, Etna's voice is somber and poetic in its simplicity.
item.content:encoded: Paul Yoon's new novel follows a dog conscripted into an unnamed war in an unnamed country. From the very first page, Etna's voice is somber and poetic in its simplicity.

item.title: 'Fed Up' author explains how evolution impacts eating, dieting and fat
item.description: Paleoanthropologist Daniel Lieberman talks about diets he's tested, and contradictory information about what's healthy to eat and what's not. He says evolution often works against weight-loss efforts.

item.title: Hayden Panettiere, who starred in 'Heroes' and 'Nashville,' dies at 36
item.description: A child actor since she was cast in various commercials as an 11-month-old, Panettiere was best known for her role as the country music star Juliette Barnes in the series Nashville.
